Renewal N(T)/T→1/E S and functional random-time-change give Lévy intensity q c* y^−q−1 dy with c*=(α−1)t0^(α−1)E Z^q. Age and unfinished continuous Brownian path rewards are tight at deterministic large T; the centered remainder is o_P(T^(1/q)). Recomputed β=1,α=5/2,t0=K=1: q=5/3 and μ=2/√π.
